# Toned intent table

<!-- Generated from scorecard/intents/intents.ts by `bun scorecard/scorecard.ts --write`. Do not edit. -->

Each author intent, its one canonical spelling, and every other spelling in use
today. The target is one spelling per intent, with every alias an error that
names the canonical spelling. Spellings that are errors (compiler or toned lint
rule) and removed spellings are listed but not counted.

21 intents, 45 spellings (mean 2.14, max 4); 4 with one spelling.

| Intent                                                          | Canonical                                                                                                                                                                              | Other spellings (status)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Spellings |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- |
| Use a value only on web                                         | `$style: { … } in a system declaring targets: ['web']` (in a system with several targets, `'@platform web': { $style: { … } }`)                                                        | `'@platform.web': { $style: { … } }` (error: `toned/canonical-platform-key` rejects it and fixes the key)<br>`...web({ … })` (app-helper: an app helper spread into a part; nine copies in two different types in HQ; replaced by `targets: ['web']`, pending the HQ migration)                                                                                                                        | 2         |
| Apply hover only on devices that can hover                      | `':hover': { … }` (core already wraps `:hover` and the source channel in `@media (hover: hover)`)                                                                                      | `'@can-hover': { ':hover': { … } }` (redundant: the media wrapper does nothing around a gated `:hover`)<br>`':row-hover': { … }` (workaround: a declared state whose selector contains `:hover` (`states: { 'row-hover': '…:hover' }`); not gated by core)<br>`'@can-hover': { ':row-hover': { … } }` (workaround: the wrapper is needed here, unlike above; an author cannot tell which case applies) | 4         |
| Style a part while an ancestor part is hovered                  | `'Card:hover': { Title: { … } }` (the source channel)                                                                                                                                  | `Card: { ':hover': { textColor: … } }` (workaround: hover on the ancestor, relying on inherited properties)<br>`':in-hovered-card': { … }` (workaround: a hand-written selector state such as `':is([data-pause]:hover > *)'`; 28 on the website, some depending on class-name strings)                                                                                                                | 3         |
| Colour an input's placeholder                                   | `placeholderColor: 'muted'` (a token whose resolver writes `bridgeVarName('placeholder', 'color')`; needs the `placeholder` bridge declared in the system)                             | `'@platform web': { $style: { '--toned-b-placeholder-color': … } }` (workaround: any `--*` key type-checks, so a misspelling is silent)<br>`$webRules: webRules({ '&::placeholder': { color: … } })` (workaround)                                                                                                                                                                                      | 3         |
| Style one of a component's own options (size, tone, appearance) | `.variants(($: Variants<Mods>) => ({ [$.size('s')]: … }))`                                                                                                                             | `':appearance-ghost': { … }` (workaround: a declared attribute state with `data-appearance` written in markup; untyped, so a misspelled value matches nothing; 211 such states on the website)                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 2         |
| Style a DOM or ARIA fact (disabled, open, checked)              | `':disabled': { … }` (a declared state)                                                                                                                                                | `$webRules: webRules({ '&[aria-disabled=true]': { … } })` (workaround: web only; native, inline and PDF reject CSS extensions)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 2         |
| Derive a stylesheet from another                                | `sheet.extend(rules, variants?)`                                                                                                                                                       | `overrideStyles(…) / overrideSheet(…)` (removed: no longer exported; HQ docs taught it until #2471)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | 1         |
| Restyle a component inside one subtree                          | `<StyleOverrides> + sheet.extend(…)` (React: the override takes sheets derived by `extend`)                                                                                            | `<StyleOverrides> + overrideSheet(…)` (removed)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | 1         |
| Open a platform block                                           | `'@platform web'` (what `q.platform('web')` returns)                                                                                                                                   | `'@platform.web'` (error: deprecated; `toned/canonical-platform-key` fixes it, and both spellings in one part are a type error)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | 1         |
| Compose shared style fragments into a part                      | `$style: [focusRing, cond && still, { … }]` (merged in order, the last wins; falsy entries are skipped; `null` unsets)                                                                 | `Root: { ...focusRing, ...still }` (error: `toned/no-shadowing-spread` reports a spread whose `$style`, platform or condition key is set again, naming the key)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | 1         |
| Declare a part's kind                                           | `$kind: 'text'`                                                                                                                                                                        | `$$type: 'text'` (compatible)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | 2         |
| Write a low-level style on a part                               | `$style: { … }`                                                                                                                                                                        | `style: { … }` (compatible)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | 2         |
| Apply a declared media condition                                | `[q.media('md')]: { … }` (returns the literal key `'@md'`)                                                                                                                             | `'@md': { … }` (compatible)<br>`'@media md': { … }` (compatible)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | 3         |
| Apply a declared container step                                 | `[q.container('field', 'wide')]: { … }`                                                                                                                                                | `'@field/wide': { … }` (compatible)<br>`'@container field wide': { … }` (compatible)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 3         |
| Animate a part when a declared state changes                    | `defineMotion(ui, { states: { ':open': transition } })` (the same declared states (or a `q.all` of them) that style the part; a Weft run passes its open waits as the `states` source) | `useMotion(open ? slow : fast)` (workaround: a new options identity replaces the controller and cancels the running transition)<br>`attachMotion(host, { states: { ':open': … } })` (error: a type error naming `defineMotion(system, { states })`, which checks the state names)                                                                                                                      | 2         |
| Animate a colour                                                | `properties: ['backgroundColor']` (interpolated in Oklab on web and native; token colours resolve through the active theme)                                                            | `'@platform web': { $style: { transition: 'background-color 200ms' } }` (workaround: web only, interpolated in sRGB, not on the shared clock, and reduced motion is left to the author)                                                                                                                                                                                                                | 2         |
| Move, scale or rotate a part                                    | `properties: ['translateY', 'scale']` (separate channels; individual CSS transform properties on web, the transform array on native)                                                   | `'@platform web': { $style: { transform: 'translateY(8px)', transition: 'transform 200ms' } }` (workaround: web only; one transform string, so translate and scale cannot be interrupted separately)                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 2         |
| Step motion time in a test or replay                            | `createTestClock() + clock.advance(ms)` (one clock shared through `attachMotion(host, motion, { clock })` or `<MotionClockProvider clock={clock}>`)                                    | `frames: driver` (compatible: one motion's own clock; it takes precedence over the shared clock)<br>`a hand-written frame driver with a pending-callback map` (workaround: what toned's own motion tests wrote before `createTestClock`)                                                                                                                                                               | 3         |
| Make a package's named outputs available to its consumers       | `"toned": { "outputs": ["src/toned/*.toned.ts"] }` (in the package's package.json; Vite, Bun, Metro and scripts find it through the dependency graph)                                  | `tonedOutputs({ outputs: ['…/*.toned.ts'] })` (compatible: explicit globs in each consumer (also `tonedBunPlugin`, `withTonedOutputs`, `loadOutput`); replace the declarations; HQ writes them in about 15 places)                                                                                                                                                                                     | 2         |
| Import `toned:` outputs from a Bun script or test               | `bun --preload @toned/core/bun/register` (or `preload` in bunfig.toml)                                                                                                                 | `Bun.plugin(tonedBunPlugin({ outputs, root }))` (compatible: a hand-written preload)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 2         |
| Write an output file's default export                           | `export default defineOutput({ css, data })` (a misspelled key, data that is not JSON or an unawaited promise is a type error; a `buildStyles` artifact may be passed as it is)        | `export default { css, data }` (compatible: not typed; the shape is checked when the output builds)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | 2         |
